lang.name: English
shell.logs.title: Run logs
chat.placeholder: Message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
chat.empty: Say something to begin. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
chat.createHint: Click + at the top right to create one.
chat.noMemory: No memory yet. Facts you write are injected into each turn (only what you write, never scraped).
chat.historyPaused: Loading history: sending is paused so late messages cannot reorder.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
chat.emptyHint: Send a message, or pick a conversation on the left.
api.lead: All {total} upstream Rust commands are registered. We do not run the DSH runtime; plugin/profile/updater/core/pet commands are deliberately skipped or pending, the rest are wired.
chat.tabHint: Which runs happened (chat gives answers, trace gives the process)
trace.empty: No runs in this scope yet.
trace.emptyHint: Send a message on the Chat tab; every step of that run lands here.
trace.noSteps: This run left no step record.
trace.noChanges: No file changes recorded for this run.
trace.usageHidden: Usage is counted per day, not per run (this page deliberately shows no per-run cost)
run.stalled: No response for {n}s. It may be stuck. Wait for the error, or do something else.
run.emptyOutput: The run finished with no output (a blank reply counts as a failure, not success).
run.errUnpaired: Core not paired yet: set an endpoint and model under Settings -> Core first.
run.errAuth: Credentials rejected: check that the key env var is set and correct.
run.errRate: Rate limited: wait before sending again instead of retrying in a loop.
run.errNetwork: Cannot reach it: check the endpoint and your network (this is not a bad key).
run.errTimeout: No reply in time: the endpoint is slow or stuck; check this request in the run log.
run.errOther: (the raw text above is the backend error; there is no more specific class for it.)
trace.liveTitle: This run's steps (from the server; covers only the latest run)
chat.stopAllHint: Protocol-level kill switch: flips the stop token of every live turn
chat.leaseHint: One-shot control lease (1-20s); expires, never auto-renews
